inputs.text: The owner of Blue Waters has it exactly right when he says the Government is collecting taxes from them without doing or investing in anything. Attempts to dress this up as some kind of environmental tax are just a weak excuse for yet another raid on productive businesses that actually sustain order and contribute to our way of life. Plastic bottles turning up everywhere and blocking rivers and drains prove these schemes deliver nothing useful. Real solutions come from personal responsibility, family values, and respect for our communities, not more interference from progressive institutions that erode tradition and national strength.
